title: Jelly world
description: A port of TypeGPU's Jelly Slider, after Voicu Apostol's design, where a jelly bends on its slotted tray until a critter pulls the lever and a candy lawn grows around it with seventeen more. Drag the jelly to stretch it, carry a critter or pull the lever yourself, and turn the view with the secondary button or two fingers and zoom with the wheel or a pinch.
line: A ray-marched jelly slider on a tray, until a critter pulls the lever and a candy world grows around it.
hint: drag the jelly to stretch or squash it
